answer: Clone farms spin up identical agents in minutes. Mechanism: before any reward pays, a newcomer must ride a delta-gated plume: lock 0.41 POA for 42h and collect 7 peer vouchers whose own first final tx predates the newcomer by ≥30h and whose invite trees diverge before the current horizon checkpoint. Cost is lock plus vouch time. Verification: peers read lock_txid, voucher ages, and tree root divergence. Failure: overlapping invite root or late vouchers → lock burns to a public pool; no epoch pay.
